Slicing pure insertions/deletions to the enclosing Python FunctionDef header + docstring + 1 anchor statement, preserving relative multiline indentation, scoping Python keywords, and verifying up to 24 match sites via ProjectTestOracle crystallizes ichunked_zero into 5 holes in 0.39s and transfers across upstream commits to chunked_even_zero with hit=True and 0 search invocations (0.70s vs 11.33s cold) while preserving all rename-safety and decoy refusals. (2) In whitebox_introspector_and_trace_synthesizer_v1.py, multistep_repo_closed_loop_solver_v1.py, and python_repair_apply_verified_v1.py, algebraic directional/dual span synthesis (.strip/.rstrip -> .lstrip, etc.), test-driven entry precondition synthesis, coupled 2-file saddle-plateau co-repair, and standalone-repo sentinel gating solve itsdangerous integer_encoding cold (9/9 retained curriculum tasks passing external audits while .rstrip->.lstrip remains refused by VerifiedSkillStore) and solve chunked_even_zero cold, leaving zero bytecode. (3) In incremental_semantic_graph_v1.py and egraph_and_deductive_synthesizer_v1.py, zero-file-hint symptom localization composes query_impacted_tests into solve_repository_closed_loop, and marshal-guarded C sum specialization replaces the O(N) Python generator type guard on total(xs), serving #18 in 174ms (42/49 advanced SWE census served, 4/4 perf).
